user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and search answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates safety of landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-triggered actions and fetches pages for ChatGPT users.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs, not automatic crawl.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to enhance AI model training, utility, and safety.
user_agents.scope: Public web content gathered for model development and training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at user direction when individuals ask questions to Claude.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content during user-initiated queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Indexes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images for Google Images and Search features displaying images.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related Search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for the Google News product.
user_agents.scope: The Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Fetches pages for Google Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible site content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Generic crawling used by various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs fetched by Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs fetched by Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Site-owner requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls whether site content is used for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rule for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search in Apple products and collects data for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General web search crawling and page rendering for Apple ecosystem services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Secondary user agent that does not crawl; governs use of Applebot-crawled data.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Restricted to URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display title, description, and thumbnail.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, citations, and links in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to train foundation AI models or index content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content for foundation model training and product improvements.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves snapshots and content for AI features and previews.
user_agents.scope: Content extraction for Bing Copilot and generative AI experiences.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to build the Bing search index.
user_agents.scope: General web crawling and indexing for Bing and Microsoft services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web pages crawled to improve products, services, and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use page-level noarchive or noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or use noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to support user-initiated actions and queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web information fetched on a user's behalf; excludes generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset of the internet for research.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages across domains on the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow CCBot in robots.txt or join the opt-out registry.
